skills.name: brownfield-chat
skills.description: Natural-language Q&A across the full codebase. Use for multi-module questions, "what breaks if", git history, cross-cutting queries, and anything spanning more than one file. For a single-file lookup use brownfield-query instead.
skills.author: wednesday-solutions

skills.name: brownfield-drift
skills.description: Enforces architecture boundaries defined in PLAN.md. Use when a PR crosses module/service boundaries, when the dev asks "are we following the architecture?", or as a scheduled architecture health check. Not for querying what a module does — use brownfield-chat for that.
skills.author: wednesday-solutions

skills.name: codebase-intel
skills.description: Unified codebase intelligence. Handles all questions about structure, logic, risk, and dependencies. Combines natural-language Q&A with deterministic lookups and pre-edit blast radius checks.
skills.author: wednesday-solutions

skills.name: deploy-checklist
skills.description: Pre-deploy and post-deploy checklist skill. Ensures env vars, migrations, CI, rollback plan, smoke tests, and monitoring are verified before and after every deployment.
skills.author: wednesday-solutions

skills.name: greenfield
skills.description: Parallel persona planning for new projects. Research agent runs first to build domain context, then Architect, PM, and Security agents run in parallel. Synthesis agent combines all perspectives into a detailed GSD-style PLAN.md with Tensions section.
skills.author: wednesday-solutions

skills.name: module-audit-agent
skills.description: Use when asked to audit a module, check its health, or assess whether it should be refactored. Runs structural query, risk check, and test generation automatically.
skills.author: wednesday-solutions

skills.name: onboard-dev-agent
skills.description: Use when a dev is new to the project, asks for an overview, or wants to get oriented quickly. Fills graph gaps then runs a guided codebase interview.
skills.author: wednesday-solutions

skills.name: pr-create
skills.description: Agent-driven PR creation skill. Validates branch, runs pre-push checklist, generates GIT-OS compliant PR title and body from commit history, detects stacked branches, then pushes and opens the PR via gh CLI.
skills.author: wednesday-solutions

skills.name: pr-review
skills.description: Fix engine for PR review comments. Fetches review comments (Gemini bot or human), categorizes by impact, posts a prioritized fix queue, and applies fixes on dev approval. Called directly for quick fixes, or internally by pr-review-agent as part of full PR review.
skills.author: wednesday-solutions

skills.name: pr-review-agent
skills.description: Full PR review orchestrator. Use when asked to review a PR or check if it is ready to merge. Runs blast radius + drift check on changed files, then hands off to pr-review for comment triage and fixes. Do NOT use pr-review directly for full reviews — use this.
skills.author: wednesday-solutions

skills.name: standards-kit
skills.description: Unified development and design standards. Enforces code quality (complexity < 8), strict naming conventions, and the mandatory use of approved UI component libraries.
skills.author: wednesday-solutions

skills.name: wednesday-git
skills.description: Unified Git workflow. Manages the entire task lifecycle: branch creation (sprint), atomic commits (git-os), and PR opening (pr-create).
skills.author: wednesday-solutions
